correctness.rationale: For every odd n=2s+1>=3 and r>=0, projective cancellation after inverse exponent H=sum_(j=0)^s S^(2j) with (I+S)H=I+J yields degree (s+1)^r minus n times the least cyclic coefficient of A(u)^r, A=1+...+u^s. The overlap formula for centered arcs on a cyclic n-gon makes convolution of radial-nonincreasing indicators radial-nonincreasing, putting a minimum at floor((rs+n)/2) mod n. Root-of-unity pairing produces the s distinct positive roots 1/(4 cos^2(pi j/n)) of the reciprocal Chebyshev polynomial; parity coefficients are nonzero (odd n prevents cosine cancellation), so BOTH parity subsequences have minimal characteristic polynomial R_s and lambda_1=1/(2sin(pi/(2n))). Independent integer cyclic convolution and recurrence checks for n=3,5,7,9,11,13 through r=27 corroborated the calculation without standing in for the proof.
